title: Delta CEO: 'Safety is going to make the call' on launching Saudi Arabia flight
summary: Delta Airlines is currently deliberating the launch of its new flight service to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, amidst safety concerns. The CEO emphasized that the decision will primarily hinge on safety considerations, particularly in light of recent Houthi attacks in the region. This cautious approach reflects the airline's commitment to passenger safety and operational integrity as it navigates the complexities of international travel.
